posts.text: I think the computer/internet revolution is more analogous to the First Industrial Revolution (1760-1840). The AI revolution will be more analogous to the Second Industrial Revolution (1870-1914). Everything happens about twice as fast now, so the AI revolution will take ~25 yrs.
